messages:
support-bot: P1 from AcmeCorp: dedicated embeddings endpoint returning 500s for ~30m. Customer: high-throughput nightly job blocked. Ticket: INC-5043. Link: https://redwood.console/incidents/5043 :rotating_light:
maya: copying logs here — stack traces show tensor-shape mismatch during model load. reported only on their Dedicated fleet in eu-west1. customer asking for hotfix asap. :eyes:
alina: @maya thanks. Lina here — what do we know about scope? Is this a model artifact mismatch (config vs weights) or runtime bug? Can we reproduce in staging?
maya: repro steps included. I reproduced with their snapshot: model load fails on quantized checkpoint. staging identical hardware reproduces 500s on load, inference returning 500s.
alex: sounds like model variant/quantization mismatch. My hunch: checkpoint metadata changed shape expectations. If so, quick options: 1) rollback to previous model snapshot for that tenant pool; 2) code hotfix to accept both shapes (riskier); 3) route traffic to hosted endpoints temporarily.
jon: routing to hosted is doable but needs CIDR and network approvals for Acme's Dedicated. Should be fastest if customer allows outbound routing — pinged security for exception.
tina: if we do rollback, we must ensure KV cache invalidation and warmup. Otherwise we'll hit cold-start latencies. Also need canary to avoid hitting other tenants.
lina: decision time: hotfix vs rollback vs hosted route. Preferences? Tradeoffs: rollback = low code risk, quick; hotfix = code change + QA + possible regression. Hosted route = requires customer approval + data plane changes.
alex: prefer rollback canary to previous snapshot. We prepare a canary for 5% of Acme traffic on eu-west1 for 15 minutes. If stable, bump to 50% then full. Rollback steps are automated via infra tooling.
maya: customer update: they prefer rollback if zero data loss and quick. They've agreed to temporary snapshot rollback.
jon: I'll prepare canary route. Suggested plan: 5% for 15m, monitor 5xx and P95. Metrics watch: 5xx >0.5% or P95 delta >+300ms triggers rollback.
tina: add error budget check: if request-error-rate >1% for 10m, auto rollback. Also ensure we run smoke tests: embedding sanity and length checks.
alex: owners: Alex (eng) will validate snapshot, Jon (infra) will run canary, Tina (SRE) monitors, Lina (PM) customer comms. Maya to update ticket + CS.
deploy-bot: canary job created: canary-id cny-5043-1. Command to start: ```redwood infra canary start --id cny-5043-1 --tenant acmecorp --region eu-west1 --percent 5 --duration 15m```
deploy-bot: CI status: preflight checks passed for snapshot rollback. No infra conflicts.
lina: launch criteria checklist before canary: 1) snapshot validated by eng (alex) 2) smoke tests green 3) rollback automation in place 4) customer notified of potential brief degradation 5) SRE runbook assigned. Mark when done.
alex: snapshot validated. smoke tests green locally. Codebase unchanged.
jon: rollback automation and canary route ready. Starting canary now.
deploy-bot: canary started cny-5043-1 at 1901234687.
tina: watching metrics dashboard: initial 5xx dropped to 0.0% for Acme canary, P95 steady. Will hold 15m.
sales-kate: I'll message Acme's procurement & eng leads with ETA and status after we hit steady 50% bump.
lina: communication plan: 1) immediate status to customer (maya) 2) 1-hr follow-up confirming canary stability (lina) 3) final confirmation & closure (lina + sales-kate) 4) postmortem and RCA in #postmortems within 48h.
maya: customer update sent: "Rolling a short canary rollback to a validated snapshot now. We'll update in 1 hour."
tina: canary at 5m stable. bumping percent to 50% suggested.
jon: bumping to 50% now. deploy-bot: canary updated cny-5043-1 -> 50% at 1901234698.
alex: monitoring looks clean. If 50% holds for 30m we'll promote to full.
lina: NOTE: if any downstream canary signals breach thresholds, immediate rollback to snapshot will be executed by infra (automated).
deploy-bot: canary metrics: 5xx=0.02%, P95 delta +20ms, error budget OK.
sales-kate: Acme acknowledged and appreciates quick action. They asked for a short changelog and rollback summary. Maya pls attach once closed.
lina: post-decision: we will treat this as candidate for a minor release investigation: engineering to add model validation at onboarding to detect checkpoint meta mismatch earlier. Alex will scope in backlog.
alex: will open backlog item with acceptance criteria: pre-deploy model metadata check, unit test against quantized checkpoints, rollout gating. ETA initial PR in 3 days.
lina: thanks team. Closing thread when promoted to full and customer confirms. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary promoted to full for tenant acmecorp at 1901234702. canary cny-5043-1 -> promoted.
maya: customer confirmed service restored. closing ticket and sending closure note with changelog and RCA ETA.
lina: follow-ups: Alex to push backlog PR, Tina to draft runbook additions, Jon to add canary automation template to docs, Maya to send customer-facing note, Sales-Kate to confirm contractual notes. We'll compile into postmortem doc.
